positions.description: Creating new desktop/web views for Target fulfillment data that will be used by Target leaders and stores. Building new front-end screens, tapping into existing APIs, building new APIs. Working with React, Node JS, Java.

volunteerExperiences.description: As Engagement Officer, I was in charge of creating and running all of the socials. This job required a lot of socializing and being the middleman between officers and members. This position involved long-term goal setting and reflection, which contained looking at how members were feeling about the organization and communicating to officers the long-term vision of our group.

Volunteered at the Austin Child Guidance Center weekly.
- Would actively engage with children before/after they received therapy services.
- Would attend and volunteer at their events such a Fall Fest.  
- Helped raise money for the center through philanthropic events with Texas Sweethearts.
